brief: A tool rack that hangs on a wall from keyhole hangers, with hooks for small hand tools.

requirements.evidence: Two hex-acc-keyhole accessories installed on rear face (slot 1) at outer cells: accessory:0#0,0#1 (q0,0,0) and accessory:0#2,0#1 (q2,0,0) on bolted 3-cell horizontal rail, spaced for two wall screws.
Three hex-acc-hook plates on front face (slot 4) at q0, q1, q2: accessory:0#0,0#4, accessory:0#1,0#4, accessory:0#2,0#4. Each plate provides two hooks (6 hooks total) for hanging small hand tools.

finish.summary: Built a 3-cell horizontal rail (0,0,0; 1,0,0; 2,0,0) bolted with two jointBolts, with keyhole hangers on the rear (slot 1 opposite front) for lift-and-drop wall mounting and three hook plates on the front (slot 4) providing six hooks. Build checks clear with no mesh clashes.

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
